takeaways.text: Azure and other cloud services grew 33%, and Microsoft Cloud revenue hit $42.4B — about 61% of all revenue. The growth story is the data centers.
takeaways.title: Azure is the growth engine

takeaways.text: Microsoft returned $9.7B in dividends and buybacks this quarter while still funding the AI buildout — the business throws off far more cash than it needs to run.
takeaways.title: Cash is flowing back to shareholders

takeaways.text: More Personal Computing grew 6% on Xbox content (+8%) and search ads (+21%), but at $13.4B it is under a fifth of revenue — the cloud and Office businesses set the pace.
takeaways.title: The PC side is steady, not driving growth

verdict: Microsoft grew 13% to $70.1B as Azure jumped 33% and the cloud passed $42B — AI demand is lifting every part of the business, even while the data-center buildout pushes costs up faster than revenue.
